nature: EXPLORATORY. The registered pre-check failed (check3: ridge gap_closed 0.090 < 0.10; random forest 0.205), so by precheck.json the formal experiment would not be run. It is run anyway on the user's explicit decision, as a deviation from precheck.json; no result here is a confirmatory finding and the report must say so. Post-hoc relative to D's frozen Test.
known_information_before_registration: precheck results (results/tables/future_B/precheck/): 52% pack lines; 65% of customers bulk-dominant; form type almost independent of RFM clusters (ARI 0.008, Cramer's V 0.069); form features add 9.0% (ridge) / 20.5% (RF) of the gap to the ceiling for predicting the Discovery category profile
tier pricing exists (median item-month rho -0.49), so relative unit price is used
all E10/E9/E5 Validation results for the RFM grouping (docs/extra_evaluation.md)
no clustering on purchase-form features has been run
population: the 2,684 Profile customers of B's frozen labels

features.source: Profile lines exactly as in precheck.json (A snapshot clean_transactions, is_valid_basket_item == 1); a basket is an invoice_id; pack(i) and relative price as in precheck.json

order_level.basket_size: log1p(distinct stock codes), capped at its 95% quantile over Profile orders and divided by it
order_level.qty_per_line: log1p(median quantity over the order's lines), capped and scaled the same way
order_level.pack_share: share of the order's lines (in the pack denominator) that are pack lines; orders with no denominator line get the order-level median
order_level.unit_price: median relative unit price over the order's lines, capped at the 95% quantile and divided by it
order_level.business_hours: 1 if Monday-Friday and hour in [9, 17), else 0

features.excluded: order value (sensitivity only, not run here); any category-based quantity (circular)
features.customer_level_for_backup: the 5 customer form features of precheck.json (customer_form_features.csv), standardized

F_main_two_stage.stage1: KMeans on the 7,738 Profile orders x 5 order features; K_order chosen below; final model = lowest inertia among the 50 stability runs at the chosen K
F_main_two_stage.K_order_rule: for K in 3..8: 50 runs KMeans(n_clusters=K, n_init=1, random_state=0..49); median pairwise ARI of the 50 labelings; choose the smallest K with median ARI >= 0.80, otherwise the K with the highest median ARI
F_main_two_stage.stage2: customer feature = share of the customer's Profile orders in each order type (Sokol & Holy eq. 11); KMeans(n_clusters=3, n_init=10, random_state=42), unscaled shares
F_main_two_stage.labels: groups renamed '0','1','2' by ascending mean customer basket_size
F_main_two_stage.K_cust: fixed at 3 (same number of groups as RFM, so rule budgets split the same way); a free-K description is not run

segmentation.F6_backup_two_step: inside each frozen RFM cluster c, KMeans(n_clusters=2, n_init=10, random_state=42) on the standardized customer form features; groups 'c-0','c-1' with '-0' the lower mean basket_size; 6 groups

comparisons_of_partitions: per-group means of customer form features and RFM
decision tree (max_depth=3, random_state=0) on the 5 customer form features predicting F, training accuracy and rules as text

random_controls.S: shuffle F labels over all customers (size only)
random_controls.A1: shuffle F labels within the A1 strata (Profile orders 1, 2, 3-4, 5-9, 10+; configs/experiment.json)
random_controls.B1: shuffle F labels within quintiles of customer basket_size
random_controls.B2: shuffle F labels within A1 strata x tertiles of customer basket_size (15 cells) -- PRIMARY control
random_controls.R1: for F6 only: shuffle F6 labels within each RFM cluster (primary control for F6)
random_controls.F6_also: S and A1 for F6 (shuffle F6 labels)

systems: G (global), L (RFM, frozen), F, F6, and every random seed

metrics.M1_category_difference: Discovery: mean over groups of Bray-Curtis between in-group and out-of-group supports of 2-category combinations (category_controls.evaluate, rest_bc_len2), and 3-category; between-group pair_bc as secondary
metrics.M2_E9: E9 per-customer lists (configs/extra_eval/E9.json), budgets 20/50/100, primary B=100; Discovery build, Validation evaluate; F - G paired customer bootstrap interval
metrics.M3_E10: E10 V1 and V3 restricted/shared coverage, budgets 20/50/100 (descriptive)
metrics.M4_E5a: E5 group-specific rules (configs/extra_eval/E5.json): Discovery -> Validation direction retention
metrics.M5_size_stratified: E9 B=100 Validation coverage computed inside order-size bins (number of stock codes in the basket's items list) 1-5, 6-15, 16-30, 31+ and averaged with the bins' order shares; F minus G and F vs B2
metrics.engine: src/online_trade/extra_eval engine and modules unchanged, P5 rules, same Pool

interpretation_rules_validation.form_adds_information: M1 rest_bc_len2 AND M2 Validation coverage of F both have empirical p <= 0.05 against B2
interpretation_rules_validation.only_basket_size: M1 or M2 has p <= 0.05 against A1 but not against B2
interpretation_rules_validation.nothing_beyond_random: neither M1 nor M2 has p <= 0.05 against A1
interpretation_rules_validation.F_vs_G: M2: interval above 0 = F lists beat G; contains 0 = tie; below 0 = worse
interpretation_rules_validation.F6: same rules with R1 in place of B2
interpretation_rules_validation.note: exploratory: these labels describe the result, they are not hypothesis tests

periods.validation: M2-M5 evaluation; nothing is selected from Validation
periods.test: NOT read in this run. Running Test requires a separate explicit user decision and a committed configs/future_B/FREEZE.json listing the frozen labels file hash
